authority.note: GO_FOR_CONTINUED_IMPLEMENTATION does not close any experiment, tracing, C1, D02 exception, normative or full-M4 gate. Every successful tested result retains no execution/runtime/acceptance authority.

decision.rationale: SEC-C0-006 is remediated in the tested current schema and SEC-C0-001 through SEC-C0-005 remain closed. No remaining concrete blocker was reproduced in this focused source/offline artifact-foundation review. This verdict permits continued implementation review work, not native execution, completed OBS1, Redis experiments or runtime acceptance.
decision.scope_limit: Focused final remediation review, not a fresh whole-repository vulnerability audit or a proof of Linux/Yama/hardware feasibility.

finding_dispositions.retained_positive_obligations: Twenty positive process-case combinations cover all five tested dispositions and four reply modes; the denied corruption control also passes. finding_dispositions.subject: Current invocation falsely treated as a no-write/replay mutation or its own replay original
finding_dispositions.verification: All six retained v2 counterexamples now reject with the intended codes. Twelve fresh append-row controls start from passing v3 baselines, retain the original/prior ledger row, append a contradictory current mutation, independently rebind the ledger, reseal every included issuer chain, validate all individual envelopes, then reject NONMUTATING_INVOCATION_EFFECT. These include early reply, late reply, affirmative no reply and unknown no reply. Eight self-original controls (including the four early/late variants) reject REPLAY_IDENTITY from otherwise well-formed current-schema inputs. A 576-vector matrix confirms that alternative effect labels, all four recovery labels and row position do not evade the current-row guard.

gate_limitations: Continued implementation is the only positive scope of this verdict. Any newly assembled adapters or changed artifacts need exact binding and independent review before a separate owner execution decision.
C0 denial remains denial: no root, C1, PR_SET_PTRACER/dumpability/parentage workaround or relaxed confinement fallback is authorized.
Actual Linux/Yama/LSM/hardware access, post-entrypoint identity and filter installation remain unproved; static compile and byte identity cannot supply those observations.

CONTINUATION_DISPATCHED is not an actual continuation/stop witness. Clock uncertainty, aggregate pauses, event/read/output/memory limits and complete owned-resource absence must be independently established.

Current schemas do not themselves prove issuer independence, physical invocation provenance or causal runtime event order. Future adapters must validate event evidence rather than trust producer assertions or metadata labels.

The prefault deny-all corruption route remains limited and requires its owner sequencing interpretation plus durable no-regrant and healthy-load controls; it does not cover authenticated COMMIT killed in flight.
The optional extinction exception is disabled. Refusal or disposal cannot supply recovered state, acknowledged durability, new BOOT, normative amendment or full-M4 acceptance.
Preparation bounds are not the full maximum-shape M4 inventory; parallel cancellation publication/CI does not confer observer or Redis authority.
No network-based dependency audit or fresh reproducible build was performed. Existing compiler/library identities are integrity bindings, not release dependency clearance.

incomplete_runtime_assembly.evidence_boundary: The pure coordinator, native message phases, producer Boolean assertions, digest equality and typed reference metadata do not establish that events occurred. No run command, completed OBS1 packet, 276-trial execution or calibration result is claimed.

independent_checks.interpretation: 41 supplied offline tests and 13 independent tests pass with zero errors, failures or skips. The independent suite includes 732 specific-code rejection assertions, 21 positive D02 controls, 264 held/240 final oracle-state checks and 36 full-schema N/F final rejections. These are synthetic contract/static-byte checks, not runtime event evidence.
independent_checks.method: Prior review counterexamples were read only as bound JSON data; no prior probe or writer script was executed. Independent positive fixtures repair/adapt the archived values to the intended valid v3 baseline. Negative payloads rebind ledger definitions and reseal actual included chains so obsolete-schema or stale-chain failures cannot establish closure. Specific expected rejection codes, not generic ValueError/FIELDS acceptance, are asserted.
